summary: A Quote client gets a full tick with its trade time, then a tick with only a new price: Firstock's ticks are partial updates, so the time it left out has not changed and the Quote frame keeps it, as on the web; the next tick with a price and its time carries that time.

notes: A tick leaves out what has not changed: docs/port/market-data-frames.md, Partial-update feeds; lead correction 2026-11-09, .lane/107/decisions.md: a field a partial packet omits is unchanged, not unknown. The time-bearing tick is ltp_then_quote's full packet.

deviations.reason: Firstock's i_last_trade_time is in epoch seconds and the web sends it unchanged as ltt; feed timestamps are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). The desktop sends the trade time in ms.

The web's Quote sends oi 0 for an equity whose tick carries no open interest (data.get("i_open_interest", 0)); a value the broker did not send is left out, never sent as 0 (docs/api/websocket-streaming/quote.md, web openalgo#2376). The desktop's Quote leaves it out.
